items.title: Aon (AON) Forms Lloyd's Syndicate 1956 For Multi Year Reinsurance Capacity
items.summary: Aon (NYSE:AON) and Blackstone are launching Cortina Syndicate 1956 at Lloyd's to expand multi-year reinsurance capacity. The Cortina vehicle is intended to bring institutional capital directly into the Lloyd's market for longer duration risk transfer. Cortina aims to start underwriting in 2027, subject to final regulatory approval and completion of the setup process at Lloyd's.
